entities.summary: Risto-Veikko Luukkonen was a Finnish architect. He is best known for designing the Töölö Sports Hall and the Olympia Terminal in Helsinki together with Aarne Hytönen, both of which are listed by Docomomo as significant examples of modern architecture in Finland.
